summary: Chemical & Mining Co of Chile Inc (SQM) filed a Form 6-K with its earnings release for Q2 and first half of 2026. The filing reports financial results only: revenues, net income, and per-share figures, along with operational updates on lithium, iodine, and specialty plant nutrition. There is no transaction, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event described. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer and does not trigger any special-situations category.
